content: We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id for a template that when applied to the given molecule reproduces electrophilic bromination of aromatic ring (forward). We have to do retrosynthetic step: given product (the molecule) we need to find template that when applied to product gives precursors (i.e., remove Br and add H). The available input data: from previous step make_8_lvl2-apply_template-3, they asked to return all possible precursors of applying the template as result of task make_8_lvl2-template_search-3 to the molecule below. The answer gave two SMILES strings (both look like same core with maybe different amide). Those are precursors? The molecule likely is a brominated aromatic compound with some substituents. The precursors given are likely the same molecule without bromine? Let's examine: SMILES: CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)C(=O)C1 . This has no Br. The second: CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1=O . Also no Br. So the product likely is brominated version of these? The template is electrophilic aromatic bromination. So template ID unknown. We need to search template catalog for forward reaction that forms halide (Br) on aromatic ring, breaking C-H bond, forming C-Br. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with functional_groups_formed: "halide"? maybe "halide". functional_groups_broken: "hydrogen"? Not sure. Let's try search with bonds formed: aromatic carbon to bromine (maybe "6-35"? but not sure). Simpler: search for templates that form halide functional group. Use functional_groups_formed: ["halide"].
